verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no sandbox org, test environment, or isolated data space for safely testing integrations or agent actions. One community report (datadog-comm-17) also says Datadog has no local option for verifying tracing and metrics before shipping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
